details.howToPractice: Choose problems that you know you can solve quickly. Focus on the steps you take to solve each problem, ensuring you understand the reasoning behind each step.
commonMistakes: Rushing through problems
Not checking work
details.proTip: Read each problem carefully, and then pause for a moment before starting to solve it. This helps ensure you understand what's being asked.

Grab a glass of water

Confusing similar concepts

keyConcepts.title: Problem Selection
keyConcepts.explanation: Choosing which problems to attempt first can impact your overall score.

keyConcepts.title: Stress Management
keyConcepts.explanation: Managing stress and staying focused during the exam is vital for performing well.

details.howToPractice: Set a timer for the practice session. Attempt a mix of problems that cover different topics from the chapters. Focus on solving each problem to the best of your ability within the time limit.
commonMistakes: Not managing time well
Letting stress affect performance
details.proTip: Before starting, take a few deep breaths. Remind yourself that this is practice, and it's okay to make mistakes. The goal is to learn and improve.

keyConcepts.title: Common Mistakes

keyConcepts.explanation: Last-minute tips and reminders can help you stay focused and perform well.

commonMistakes: Not reviewing key formulas
Forgetting last-minute tips
details.proTip: Visualize yourself successfully completing the exam. Confidence can make a significant difference in how well you perform.

Plan your morning

details.whatYoureDoing: You're making sure you're fully prepared for the exam, both physically and mentally, to ensure you can perform at your best.

keyConcepts.title: Physical Preparation
keyConcepts.explanation: Ensuring you have all necessary materials and a plan for the morning of the exam.

keyConcepts.title: Mental Preparation
keyConcepts.explanation: Getting into the right mindset to tackle the exam with confidence and focus.

keyConcepts.title: Logistical Preparation
keyConcepts.explanation: Double-checking the exam time, location, and what you need to bring.

details.howToPractice: Make a checklist of everything you need to do or bring. Visualize yourself waking up on time, getting to the exam location without issues, and feeling confident and ready.
commonMistakes: Forgetting essential items
Not planning the morning
details.proTip: Lay out your clothes and pack any necessary items the night before to save time and reduce stress in the morning.
